name: VistaJet
verdict: Owned by Vista Global, the Dubai-headquartered private aviation group founded by Thomas Flohr, who says he will always keep the majority; outside investors include an RRJ Capital-led consortium and long-standing investor Rhône Group. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: RRJ Capital (Richard Ong's private Asian investment firm) led a $600m equity round in March 2025 with Andalusian Private Capital; Rhone Group is a long-standing investor. No state or state fund sourced in the chain; Flohr (Swiss) held 84% per an April 2024 Bloomberg report.
